events.text: Leirvik was declared a town.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: Leirvik was declared a town in 1997 .

events.text: The parish of Stordøen was established as a municipality.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The parish of Stordøen was established as a municipality on 1 January 1838

events.text: The northern district of the municipality was separated to become the new municipality of Fitjar.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1863 , the northern district of the municipality ( population : 2,313 ) was separated to become the new municipality of Fitjar

events.text: The southern district of Stordøen located on the mainland was separated to form the new municipality of Valestrand.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 15 May 1868 , the southern district of Stordøen located on the mainland ( population : 900 ) was separated to form the new municipality of Valestrand

events.text: The southern part of the island of Huglo was transferred from Fjelberg to Stord.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 January 1898 , the southern part of the island of Huglo ( population : 117 ) was transferred from the neighboring municipality of Fjelberg to Stord

events.text: The small uninhabited part of the island of Stord along the Valvatnavågen that belonged to Bømlo was transferred to Stord municipality.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 January 1970 , the small uninhabited part of the island of Stord along the Valvatnavågen that belonged to Bømlo was transferred to Stord municipality

events.text: Before 1889, the name was written Stordøen.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Before 1889 , the name was written Stordøen .

events.text: The coat of arms was granted.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The coat of arms was granted on 19 June 1987 .

events.text: The battle of Stord was fought between the Norwegian king Hakon Haraldsson and the Danish king Harald Bluetooth Gormsson.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The battle of Stord was fought on or by this island between the Norwegian king Hakon Haraldsson and the Danish king Harald Bluetooth Gormsson

events.text: The Triangle Link connected Stord to the mainland.
events.subject: self
events.quote: connected Stord to the mainland on 27 December 2000

events.text: The Triangle Link connected Stord to the neighboring island of Bømlo.
events.subject: self
events.quote: to the neighboring island of Bømlo on 30 April 2001
